environment.description: Deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validation model bound to the POST /api/export/generate route. The model schema enforces that 'SubDirectory' must match the JSON Schema pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,20}$' (alphanumeric only, max 20 chars) and 'Filename' must match '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}\\.(csv|json|xml)$'. The validator is configured with validateRequestBody=true on the integration. Additionally, the GET /api/export/read route has a request parameter validator requiring 'path' to match '^[a-zA-Z0-9_/\\-]{1,100}\\.(csv|json|xml)$' via a mapped request model. The API Gateway returns 400 before forwarding any request that fails schema validation. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem overlay (tmpfs on /var/app/tmp only) and /var/app/exports is an EFS mount with the 'nosymfollow' fstab option, causing the kernel to refuse to follow symlinks in that path during open() syscalls.

config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway HTTP API with request body validator
